name: Mindanao Boobook
rangeDescription: Philippines (basilan, mindanao, siargao, and dinagat)
description: A fairly small owl of lowland forest on Mindanao. Dark brown on the head and upperparts with speckles on the wing, a reddish-brown chest, a white belly with thick reddish-brown streaking, and yellowish eyes.

name: Masatierra Petrel
rangeDescription: Juan fernández, san ambrosio, and san félix islands (off chile)
description: Small but rather stocky and stout-billed petrel of subtropical eastern Pacific and Humboldt Current; not seen from mainland. One of several similar species, Masatierra is best identified by gray head and collar at sides of neck, rather stout bill, and plain grayish tail without a black tip.

name: Purple-crowned Lorikeet
rangeDescription: Semiarid lowlands of southwestern and southeastern australia, including kangaroo island
description: Small green lorikeet with pale blue underparts. Note orange and yellow check patch, purple crown, yellow above the bill, and red patches in front of the eyes.

name: White-eared Solitaire
rangeDescription: East slope of andes of peru and western bolivia (la paz and cochabamba)
description: Beautiful, boldly patterned bird of montane forest. Reddish brown above, black below, with a black head, broad white mustache, and coral red bill.

name: Floreana Mockingbird
rangeDescription: Galapagos (champion and gardner)
description: A fairly large gray-and-white songbird with a long tail, curved bill, and black blotches on sides of breast. Endemic to Galápagos.

name: Acre Tody-Tyrant
rangeDescription: Southwestern amazonia in brazil (eastern acre), adjacent southeastern peru (madre de dios), and far northeastern bolivia
description: A small, drab, recently-discovered flycatcher. Has an olive-green back, a buff-streaked olive throat and breast, and a yellowish lower belly.

name: Uganda Woodland-Warbler
rangeDescription: Primary forest of gabon to northeastern democratic republic of the congo, uganda, and western kenya
description: A small, active warbler of lowland and mid-elevation forest understory that is green above and gray below with a noticeable pale eyebrow. Similar to migratory warblers, especially Willow Warbler, but note Uganda Woodland-Warbler’s grayer underparts, paler throat, and yellowish vent.
imageCreditName: Lars Petersson | My World of Bird Photography

name: Seram Mountain-Pigeon
rangeDescription: Montane forest of seram (southern moluccas)
description: A very distinctive large, long-tailed pigeon from the island of Seram. Shows a pale gray crown and neck, an extensive reddish bare skin mask around the eye, a yellow-orange bill with a red base, a pale pinkish throat and chest, and a burgundy belly.

name: Nightingale Island Finch
rangeDescription: Nightingale island (south atlantic ocean)
description: A small lemon-olive finch with a gray patch in front of the eye. Female is smaller, duller, and streakier than the male.

name: Rufous-faced Crake
rangeDescription: Marshes of southeastern paraguay, bolivia (beni), and adjacent southeastern brazil
description: Very secretive crake with a relatively long tail and a stout bill. Note the rufous neck and crown that contrast with a black back, the thinly barred black-and-white sides, and the white belly.

name: Baird's Flycatcher
rangeDescription: Arid southwestern ecuador to northwestern peru (lima)
description: Large, stout-billed flycatcher restricted to arid areas and oases of northwestern Peru and western Ecuador. Distinctive in range, with yellow belly, chestnut wings and tail, and black mask.

name: Kai Besar White-eye
rangeDescription: Kai besar (kai islands)
description: A small green songbird with a bold white eye-ring and a primarily white underside, except for a yellow throat and base to undertail. Usually found in pairs or singly, roaming through forest, woods, and gardens in lowlands and lower hills.

name: Inti Tanager
rangeDescription: Incompletely known; breeds in northern bolivia (machariapo valley in la paz); migratory, probably wintering in lower montane forest in southeastern peru, where currently known from a few sightings in cusco (kosñipata valley)
description: A remarkable new species of tanager described to science in 2021. It breeds in and around the Machariapo Valley in western Bolivia from roughly November to March, then disperses northward along the east slope of Andes into southern Peru.

name: Carunculated Fruit-Dove
rangeDescription: Obi (north-central moluccas)
description: A unique small, colorful fruit-dove confined to Obi island. Pale gray head contrasts with mostly emerald-green body, except for gray markings on the wings and back, a deep maroon belly patch, and a lemon-yellow vent and undertail.

name: Gray Catbird
rangeDescription: Southern british columbia to gulf states; winters to west indies and panama
description: Medium-sized songbird with a smooth gray body, black cap, and rusty-red undertail coverts. Sexes alike.

name: Dusky Nightjar
rangeDescription: Montane forest of costa rica and western panama
description: Small dark nightjar with very limited range in the highlands of Costa Rica and Panama. Few obvious plumage features: entire body is intricately patterned with dark brown, black, and buff.

name: Crow Honeyeater
rangeDescription: New caledonia
description: Large, mostly black honeyeater that is now rare and local in remnant patches of primary forest. Black plumage accentuated by patches of bright red facial skin.
imageCreditName: Lars Petersson | My World of Bird Photography

name: Rand's Warbler
rangeDescription: Rainforest of eastern madagascar
description: Plain, warbler-like tetraka with a bold white eye-stripe. Madagascar endemic that is found in low and middle-elevation rainforest.

name: White-rumped Shrike
rangeDescription: Southeastern south sudan and uganda to ethiopia, somalia, kenya, and tanzania
description: A big fluffy shrike with unusual white and dark brown coloration. Note the white crown and the white rump patch that is conspicuous in floppy flight.

name: Red-knobbed Coot
rangeDescription: Southern spain and morocco; eastern and southern africa and madagascar
description: Mostly sooty gray waterbird with a white beak and frontal shield. Breeding adults have two small reddish horns, but at other times difficult to separate from Eurasian Coot.
